title: Physical Resiliencies: Indicators and Mechanisms in the Elderly (PRIME)
description: In this study, we utilized single-cell RNA sequencing and flow cytometry to characterize latent cytomegalovirus (CMV) infection at the transcriptional level in older individuals (aged 60 and above) at baseline (using peripheral blood; PBMCs). We investigated the molecular circulating immune-related differences between CMV-positive (CMV+) and CMV-negative (CMV-) subjects. Our findings indicate that CMV+ individuals exhibit significantly higher signatures of cytotoxicity, such as an expansion of GZMK+ CD8+ T-cells. Furthermore, we developed a machine learning classifier _CMVerify--that accurately predicts CMV serostatus using scRNAseq data.
